tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one emphasis colour: filled buttons, the FAB, the active indicator of a selected nav item, a switch that is on, slider and progress fills, links, the text cursor.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: A quieter fill with the brand in it: the FAB, the current day and date-range bands, a featured highlight, text selection. Selected rows, chips and nav indicators use secondary-container.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting accent where primary would compete: filter-chip checks, a secondary progress track, a selected segment's check.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: The segmented button's selected segment, the navigation rail and drawer indicator, a tonal button beside a filled one.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-container.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: The warm counter-accent (copper). Use sparingly for contrast in data, badges of a second kind, and the one highlight on an otherwise blue screen.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Warm highlight fills: a featured card, an onboarding tip, a "new" marker.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tertiary-container.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, invalid field outlines and supporting text, the error icon. Always pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text and icons on error.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Error banners and snackbars, a destructive confirmation's icon well.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on error-container.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed states: a success icon, a passed check. Paired with a word or icon; it differs from error in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Success banners and toasts.

tokens.name: on-success-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success-container.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution states: the warning icon and a caution fill. Paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Warning banners.

tokens.name: on-warning-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-container.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The window ground. Body copy is on-surface on it.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: A ground that recedes: the area behind a sheet on large screens, the canvas of a docked workspace.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: A ground that comes forward in dark themes: a pane beside a dim one.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: The lowest container: a card on a busy page, the content of a data table.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Cards (elevated), the modal navigation drawer, bottom sheets at rest.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: The navigation bar and rail, menus, the default container.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Dialogs, search bars, filled text fields at rest, date pickers.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Filled text fields, the switch track when off, the progress track, input chips.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface and container.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholders, supporting text, inactive icons, unselected nav labels.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Boundaries that must be seen: outlined buttons, outlined fields at rest, checkbox and radio rings, chip outlines. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines that separate but are not controls.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbars and plain tooltips: a surface in the opposite theme.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: An action button on inverse-surface (the snackbar's action).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2px outside the control. Holds 3:1 or better on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs, drawers and sheets at 32% opacity.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The shadow colour of every elevation level.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The logo's ink and the seed of the primary palette. Marks, the app icon and the cover only; UI uses primary.

tokens.name: text-selection
tokens.usage: Selected text in fields and selectable text; text on it stays on-primary-container. When the window is inactive, selection uses surface-container-highest.

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: A visited link, in web and documentation views only. App navigation never shows visited.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Blue: the first series, the brand hue. Chart marks on surface; series also differ by stroke style (solid, dashed, dotted) and by direct labels, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Copper: the second series. Chart marks on surface; series also differ by stroke style (solid, dashed, dotted) and by direct labels, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Teal-green: the third series. Chart marks on surface; series also differ by stroke style (solid, dashed, dotted) and by direct labels, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Violet: the fourth series. Chart marks on surface; series also differ by stroke style (solid, dashed, dotted) and by direct labels, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Amber: the fifth series. Chart marks on surface; series also differ by stroke style (solid, dashed, dotted) and by direct labels, never by colour alone.

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Cyan: the sixth series. Chart marks on surface; series also differ by stroke style (solid, dashed, dotted) and by direct labels, never by colour alone.

families.sans: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Roboto, "Noto Sans", Cantarell, system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", Roboto, "Noto Sans", Cantarell, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "Cascadia Code", "SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, "Roboto Mono", "JetBrains Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: Hero numbers and one-word statements on expanded layouts.

styles.name: display-medium
styles.usage: Onboarding and empty-state headlines on large screens.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: The time picker's clock face digits; big stats in dashboards.

styles.name: headline-large
styles.usage: A page's title on expanded layouts.

styles.name: headline-medium
styles.usage: A page's title on medium layouts; the large top app bar.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: Dialog titles; a page's title on compact layouts.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: The small top app bar; a sheet's title.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: Card titles, list headers, a pane's header.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Section heads inside cards and menus; tab labels on desktop.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: Body copy on touch hosts; field input text on touch; list headlines.
styles.sample: Changes save when you leave the field.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Body copy on pointer hosts; supporting text in lists and dialogs.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Field supporting text, table meta, captions under media.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Navigation bar labels, field labels in dense forms, badges with words.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Count badges, timestamps in chips, axis labels.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap: joined segments, edge-to-edge media.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to badge, label to its supporting text, chip icon inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls in a row; icon to label inside a button.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card content gap; between chips; list item vertical padding (dense).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding of cards, list items, sheets, dialogs' inner blocks; compact page margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between form fields on pointer hosts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; medium and expanded page margins; between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of an empty state; hero padding on medium.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major regions on expanded layouts.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding on expanded layouts.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed media, docked bars, the app bar, data table cells.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Snackbars, plain tooltips, tags, text fields (outlined all round, filled top corners), checkbox marks (2px inner).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, menus, small cards, segmented buttons on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, the date picker's day cells on desktop, image thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Navigation drawer's open edge, FAB, rich tooltips, extended FAB.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets' top corners, the search bar, large FAB.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, the navigation indicator pill, switches, sliders, progress, avatars, count badges.

shadow.note: Elevation is shadow plus a tonal step: a raised surface also moves one surface-container step. Two layers, key and ambient, in the shadow colour.

tokens.name: elevation-0
tokens.usage: Flat: filled cards, navigation rail, docked toolbars.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Elevated cards, elevated buttons, the top app bar once content scrolls under it, a switch thumb.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Menus, the navigation bar when content scrolls under it, a hovered elevated card, a dragged list item's rest.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: The FAB, dialogs, date and time pickers, search view, modal sheets.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: A hovered FAB; a dragged card or chip.

tokens.name: elevation-5
tokens.usage: A dragged list item or window tab, lifted above everything.

state.note: A state layer is the content colour laid over the container at this opacity. Pressed also starts a ripple from the touch point on touch hosts.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Pointer over an enabled control.

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus, in addition to the focus ring.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed or touched; the ripple's peak.

tokens.name: state-dragged
tokens.usage: A dragged item's layer.

tokens.name: state-disabled-container
tokens.usage: A disabled control's container: on-surface at this opacity.

tokens.name: state-disabled-content
tokens.usage: A disabled control's label and icon: on-surface at this opacity.

tokens.name: scrim-opacity
tokens.usage: The scrim behind modals.

size.note: Heights of controls by density. Touch hosts use the default column; pointer hosts may drop one step (density -1), dense tool UIs two (density -2). Targets never drop below target-pointer.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Density -2 (dense tool windows): icon buttons, table row controls.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Density -1 (desktop): chips, small buttons, dense text fields, segmented buttons on desktop.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, icon buttons, segmented buttons, search bar on desktop.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Touch list rows (one line), menu items on touch, tabs.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Text fields, list rows with an avatar, the FAB, the search bar on touch.

tokens.name: app-bar
tokens.usage: The small top app bar; the navigation bar is 80px with labels.

tokens.name: nav-bar
tokens.usage: The bottom navigation bar with labels.

tokens.name: nav-rail
tokens.usage: The navigation rail's width.

tokens.name: nav-drawer
tokens.usage: The navigation drawer's maximum width.

tokens.name: target-touch
tokens.usage: The minimum touch target on Android, iOS (44pt floor) and touch Web.

tokens.name: target-pointer
tokens.usage: The minimum target with a fine pointer; dense UIs still pad to it.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Icons in 24px desktop chrome: status bar, tab close buttons, tree disclosure.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and chips.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Standard icons: app bars, lists, navigation, icon buttons.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty-state icons on compact; large list leading icons.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: The focus ring's stroke.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: The gap between a control and its ring.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Dividers and outlines.

tokens.name: outline-focused
tokens.usage: A field's or outlined control's outline while focused.

tokens.name: window-medium
tokens.usage: From 600: medium. Navigation rail, two-column forms, sheets become dialogs.

tokens.name: window-expanded
tokens.usage: From 840: expanded. List-detail panes, persistent drawer optional.

tokens.name: window-large
tokens.usage: From 1200: large. Persistent navigation drawer, three panes.

tokens.name: window-xlarge
tokens.usage: From 1600: extra-large. Content caps at a readable width; extra space becomes margins.

tokens.name: duration-short-1
tokens.usage: Ripple start, colour of a pressed state.

tokens.name: duration-short-2
tokens.usage: Hover and focus layers, a checkbox tick.

tokens.name: duration-short-3
tokens.usage: A switch thumb, a chip selection, small icon morphs.

tokens.name: duration-short-4
tokens.usage: Tooltips in, menu items fade.

tokens.name: duration-medium-1
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers open.

tokens.name: duration-medium-2
tokens.usage: Expanding a disclosure, the nav indicator sliding.

tokens.name: duration-medium-3
tokens.usage: Sheets and drawers sliding in; a card expanding to a detail view.

tokens.name: duration-medium-4
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets enter.

tokens.name: duration-long-1
tokens.usage: Full-screen dialogs and large container transforms.

tokens.name: duration-long-2
tokens.usage: Page transitions, a list-detail container transform.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: The delay between successive items entering (menu items, FAB menu actions, list items).

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Utility motion that begins and ends on screen.

tokens.name: ease-emphasized-decelerate
tokens.usage: Things entering: dialogs, sheets, menus, snackbars.

tokens.name: ease-emphasized-accelerate
tokens.usage: Things leaving for good.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Indeterminate progress, colour cross-fades only.
